title: We are launching our own game: LapRadar League
caption: We are launching our own racing game! A weekly race on phone and PC, right in the browser, free. Build your driver and pick your car colours. Starts Monday 00:00 UTC, be the first winner of the week. lapradar.com → LapRadar League #LapRadar #LapRadarLeague #racing #game #browsergame

scenes.say: We are launching our own game!
On your phone or your computer, right in the browser.
Build your driver: helmet, visor, number.
Four classes by device and camera.
Be the first winner of the week!
